subject: MAP Kickoff: Aurora Health - MAP draft & timeline options
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@aurorahealth.com>, Michael Lee <michael.lee@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: MAP Kickoff: Aurora Health - MAP draft & timeline options

Hi Sara and Michael -

Thanks again for a productive discovery call this morning. Per our conversation, I'm attaching an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft to align on milestones, owners, and a target close window. High-level recap from the call:

- Primary business goal: reduce inference cost for clinical summarization workflows while keeping p95 latency < 300ms.
- Key success metrics: 30% token-cost reduction and stable 99.9% availability for production endpoints.
- Decision stakeholders: Procurement, IT Security, and Clinical Product.

Attached: aurora_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx (MAP overview + suggested milestones).

Proposed MAP (summary):
- Milestone 1 - Technical deep dive & security review
  - Owner (Aurora): Michael Lee (IT Security)
  - Owner (Redwood): Aditya Rao (Solutions Engineer)
  - Target: within 1 week
- Milestone 2 - Pilot integration + perf validation
  - Owner (Aurora): Engineering lead (TBD)
  - Owner (Redwood): Marissa/Aditya
  - Target: 3-4 weeks after tech deep dive
- Milestone 3 - Procurement & contracting
  - Owner (Aurora): Sara Thompson (Procurement)
  - Owner (Redwood): Marissa (Sales)
  - Target: aligned with legal redlines (see options below)
- Milestone 4 - Production rollout & handoff to Customer Success
  - Owners: Aurora Engineering + Redwood CS
  - Target: post-contract

Timeline options (choose one):
- Option A (Aggressive): 6 weeks to close from today (target close: 2027-02-26) - requires prioritized tech review and parallel procurement work.
- Option B (Conservative): 10 weeks to close (target close: 2027-03-26) - accommodates standard legal review cycles and procurement windows.

Asks: 
1) Please confirm the right Aurora stakeholders (names & emails) for each milestone so I can update the MAP.
2) Which timeline option works better for your procurement/legal cadence?
3) Do you have any mandatory dependencies (e.g., internal security attestations, procurement blackout dates) we should be aware of?

Next steps I propose:
- I'll update the attached MAP with your confirmed stakeholders and send a final version.
- Schedule a 60-min technical deep dive with Aditya and Michael next week (proposed times below).

Proposed times for Tech Deep Dive (PT):
- Mon 1/18 10:00-11:00am
- Tue 1/19 2:00-3:00pm

If either of you want a different day/time, let me know and I'll adapt.

Thanks - looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0142

Attachment: aurora_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx (MAP draft, milestones, ownership columns)

From: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@aurorahealth.com>

Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 16:02:00 -0800

Marissa -

Thanks for the clear recap and the draft MAP. Appreciate how you laid out milestones and owners. Quick confirmations from our side: 

Stakeholders (please add to the MAP):
- Sara Thompson - Procurement Lead - sara.thompson@aurorahealth.com (Owner: Procurement/Contracting)
- Michael Lee - IT Security Director - michael.lee@aurorahealth.com (Owner: Security Review)
- Dr. Priya Natarajan - Clinical Product - priya.natarajan@aurorahealth.com (Stakeholder for clinical sign-off)
- Javier Morales - Engineering Manager - javier.morales@aurorahealth.com (Owner for pilot integration)

Timeline: we prefer Option B (Conservative) given our quarterly procurement windows - target close 2027-03-26. Procurement has an internal review cycle that typically takes 4-6 weeks after we submit initial order forms; legal will need the draft SLA for review.

Dependencies / notes: 
- Please provide a short security one-pager and SOC2 evidence to accelerate IT review (Michael - I've looped you on this).
- Procurement blackout: week of 2/8-2/12 is difficult for us due to year-end budgeting.

I'm attaching our internal procurement timeline to give context. Can you also add Legal (general counsel) as a reviewer once you have the contract skeleton?

Looking forward to the tech deep dive - Tue 1/19 2pm PT works for Michael and me.

Best,
Sara Thompson
Procurement Lead | Aurora Health
sara.thompson@aurorahealth.com
Attachment: procurement_timeline.pdf
